## Trump’s Immigration Rating Has Reversed

The newest Economist/YouGov poll that measured this issue found 40 percent approving of Trump’s handling of immigration and 53 percent disapproving.

Conducted from August 7 to 10, 2026, the survey included 1,589 U.S. adult citizens and had a margin of error of plus or minus 3.2 percentage points after weighting.
